summary: Iteration 10 — verified all 5 P1/P2/P3 enhancements (Excel export, engineer project scoping, per-project assignment, Drive backup of SV collections, image compression). Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (10 new + 13 regression from iter9). Frontend: all admin/engineer flows behave as designed.

issues: React hydration warning: "In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>". Caused by the platform-injected x-component data-* span wrapper inside <option> tags. Harmless functionally (selects still work) but pollutes console. Not blocking.

verified_features: GET /api/site-visits/export/excel returns 200 + xlsx content-type + attachment header (no filter, ?month=YYYY-MM, ?engineer_id, ?project_id all work).
Excel workbook contains 'Visits' sheet (16 cols) and 'By Engineer' sheet (4 cols).
Path collision regression: GET /api/site-visits/{vid} still returns 200 (the new /export/excel route is correctly declared before /{vid}).
Engineer scoping on export: when engineer calls /export/excel, only their own visits are included (admin's TEST visit excluded; engineer's own visit present).
Engineer scoping on /api/projects: admin sees both A & B; engineer sees only assigned A; after PUT adds engineer to B, engineer immediately sees B too.
Drive/local backup JSON dump confirmed to include site_visits, site_visit_templates, and users collections (verified via /api/backup/run + on-disk JSON).
Frontend ProjectFormPage: data-testid=assigned-engineers section renders engineer chips (test_engineer chip exists, toggles selection correctly persisting via save).
Frontend ProjectDetailPage: green 'New Site Visit' button (data-testid=detail-btn-new-site-visit) links to /site-visits/new?project_id=<id>.
Frontend SiteVisitFormPage: useSearchParams correctly pre-selects project — verified select-project value matches PID after navigation with ?project_id=.
Frontend SiteVisitsPage admin: month picker + Export button visible; clicking Export hits /api/site-visits/export/excel with 200 + xlsx content-type (downloadFile blob bearer flow).
Frontend PDF download (row button): downloadFile axios-bearer flow returns 200 application/pdf.
Frontend RBAC: engineer SV page shows NO Export button and NO month picker (admin-only UI correctly gated).
Backend engineer scoping verified end-to-end: GET /api/projects with engineer token returns exactly 1 project (the assigned one).
action_items: (Cosmetic, non-blocking) Console hydration warning re: <span> inside <option> caused by platform inspector instrumentation. No app-code change required unless build pipeline can opt-out of x-component data-* wrapping for <option> children.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 4058 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules (auth, projects, site_visits, audits, backup, documents, clients) as the codebase grows.
Excel export endpoint correctly placed before /{vid} — good. Same care needed for any future /site-visits/<static-segment> routes.
Image compression is canvas-side only (browser) — for non-JS clients (mobile webview camera intent) the original-size file may still be uploaded. Consider a backend size cap as a defense in depth.

rca of the issue: No bugs found. Investigated initial Playwright timeout — root cause was navigating to /site-visits before the post-login redirect settled. Re-running with `wait_for_url(not /login)` + 1500ms grace resolved it. The earlier 'first project id = new' issue was because the first matched <a href^='/projects/'> was the '/projects/new' button; resolved by querying the API directly and filtering.
